purpose: A 24-hour dial with noon at the top: one hand revolves per day and the ring shows sunrise to sunset in the accent, the rest in dusk. Sun times come from a local NOAA computation, so there is no offline state.

night.recipe: Dusk, ticks and ink flip with the palette; the daylight arc stays the accent.

options.intent: Leave 0,0 for the schematic 06:00 to 18:00 band; set both coordinates for real sun times.
Degrees east, negative west; only meaningful together with latitude.
Sunrise and sunset labels at the band ends; off for a bare ring.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not put midnight at the top
antiPatterns.why: noon at top is the solar convention (hand high means sun high), deliberately opposite to Depletion

specless: One 24-hour solar hand and an arc; the hour, minute and second vocabulary does not describe it.
